title: 创作者或机构主页
goal: 理解身份、贡献、作品与公开联系边界。
workflow: 将人物身份、公司身份和作品贡献角色分开。
按作品而非截图去重，列出贡献范围与来源。
关注和联系方式遵循可见权限，匿名状态提供明确入口。
failure_recovery: 个人资料不公开或账户删除时提供不泄漏信息的替代状态。
motion_contract: 作品预览可用键盘和触屏进入，减少动画不隐藏文本。
source_relationship_note: An outbound work-detail association does not certify that every current inner page won an award or matches a historical version.
evidence_note: Only recorded observations are facts. DOM structure does not prove visual composition, hidden state, source code, backend behavior or licenses. The runnable blueprint is an original recipe, not a source-site clone.

acceptance: 理解身份、贡献、作品与公开联系边界。
个人资料不公开或账户删除时提供不泄漏信息的替代状态。
作品预览可用键盘和触屏进入，减少动画不隐藏文本。
320、390、768、1440 宽度不出现整页横溢出；必要表格在独立区域滚动。
键盘可进入、操作、关闭对话框并返回触发点；错误不只靠颜色。
本地预览不得暗示真实支付、投稿、消息、账户或预约已生效。
limitations: Source interaction audit is not automatically performed
Real backend, production and physical-device acceptance are not included

creator_contract.implementation: Original fictional studio, eight complete authored projects and CSS illustrations; provider report values are marked fictional
creator_contract.identity: Separate organization/person, location-or-null, declared services and per-work contribution; no borrowed logos, source biography or artwork
creator_contract.counts: Provider metrics remain explicit zero or null, separate from full local catalog, matching query total and visible group. Study selection labels are not real awards.
creator_contract.browsing: Search complete local title/body/contribution; confirmed filters, reveal groups, grid/list, deep reading and origin focus/scroll restoration
creator_contract.shortlist: One owned localStorage key; explicit device action, tab-only write fallback and truthful removal failure. No account follow, notifications or cloud sync
creator_contract.privacy: 403/404 and minimal unavailable data clear profile UI. Static HTML is public fictional data, not a privacy enforcement mechanism; real services must authorize before delivering data or HTML.
creator_contract.editing: Regenerate static content after profile.json edits; complete public fallback survives scripts/data errors; unavailable render carries no identity or works
source_boundaries: Anonymous Follow opens login; no authenticated write
Reported source awards not independently audited
Two source submissions do not prove full career history
Original filtering/reveal/read-return are authored extensions, not operated source controls
